english: Why did you slay the great bull? I slew it for the gods. Who receives the first portion? The fire receives the first portion. Then the guests and the old men receive their own. Which portion do you want? I want the thigh! The heavenly ones receive the thigh. Take the tongue, son. I will take it.

pie: kʷíd bʰréh₂ter lówksneh₂ h₁léwdʰeti pós-kʷe néḱt? mr̥yétor h₂éti-kʷe ǵn̥h₁yétor. kʷís h₁ésyeh₂s méh₂tēr? h₁ésyeh₂s méh₂tēr nókʷts. lówksneh₂ nos sh₁ésonm̥ déyḱeti. lówksneh₂ey kh₂nómes? gʷénh₂es h₁ésyeh₂ey kʷsépi kh₂nónti. téh₂bʰi ḱóm kh₂nḗsi? méh₂tr̥h₁ moy ḱóm kh₂nṓh₂.
english: Brother, why does the moon grow and then vanish? She dies, and she is born again. Who is her mother? Her mother is Night. The moon shows us the harvest time. Do we sing to the moon? The women sing to her at night. Will you sing with them? I will sing with my mother.

pie: pótey h₂élbʰit pékʷetor. kʷóm h₁íd skinédesi? h₁íd h₂éyeri skinédoh₂. nu dʰǵʰméy méh₂trey h₂mélǵos séykʷomes h₁yéh₂ h₂élbʰit bʰéret. kʷíd h₁ésyeh₂ey h₂mélǵos dedh₃més? h₂élet nos h₁íh₂m̥-kʷe h₂élomes. h₂élbʰit léǵēsi? h₁íd léǵōh₂ h₁íd-kʷe pékʷōh₂.
english: Husband, the barley is ripening. When will you cut it? I will cut it at daybreak. Then we will pour out milk for Mother Earth, who bore the barley. Why do we give her milk? She fed us, and we feed her. Will you gather the barley? I will gather it, and I will cook it.
